title: Nexus
thesis: Nexus explains why the route through optimization matters even when final loss looks the same.
audience_action: Swipe away seeing loss as a landscape route, not a single number.

slides.headline: Same loss. Different model.
slides.body: Two models can tie on pretraining loss and still land in different downstream regions.

slides.headline: Loss is a scoreboard.
slides.body: A scoreboard tells you the number. It does not tell you where training landed.

slides.headline: Downstream tasks live in valleys.
slides.body: If a model lands near useful downstream valleys, adaptation gets easier.

slides.headline: Do tasks pull together?
slides.body: Nexus asks whether task directions agree or fight with each other during training.

slides.headline: Clone. Step. Measure.
slides.body: Temporary inner steps estimate how training moves the model under task batches.

slides.headline: Nexus changes the route.
slides.body: The paper is about shaping the training path, not just lowering one final score.
